text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer.
My name is Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become a star Umamusume.
Dazzling, captivating, unable to be looked away from—
a golden star like that."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I know well that it won't be easy.
Still, I'm more patient than I look.
So, I'll be in your care."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
